title: What is Saul to Us?
thesis: Trials, not spiritual experiences or good works, reveal the tested genuineness of our faith by showing whether we love God for himself or merely use him to get what we want.

title: Productive Problem Solving
thesis: When God's people solve problems without remembering His faithfulness, fearing Him appropriately, and acting from their identity as His chosen people, they create destructive consequences that can last for generations, but Jesus Christ remains the ultimate solution to all our failed problem-solving.

title: The Father's Joy - The parable of the Prodigal Son
thesis: God joyfully receives repentant sinners, and He calls self-righteous sinners to join the celebration.

title: Do Eden Anyway: Wine
thesis: God calls His people — especially the young — to a life of intentional cheerfulness rooted in grace, rejecting both hedonistic indulgence and scrupulous asceticism in favor of humble, self-forgetful joy before the face of a loving Creator.

title: That Hideous Lecture: The Severed Head
thesis: Jesus Christ heals broken hierarchies by embodying both supreme authority and total submission, making possible a social order where honor runs upward, provision runs downward, and every superior owes more than he receives.

title: Do Eden Anyway: Wife
thesis: The spouse we long to enjoy becomes enjoyable only when we express commitment, investment, and effort—primarily through speaking the gospel, God's promises, and words of love—so that marriage becomes a lifelong partnership of mutual sanctification and praise.
